spans.s: vāt-ādeya (EI 32), ‘income resulting from storms’; same as vāta-pratyāya.
vāta-pratyāya (EI 32; CII 4), explained by some as ‘octroi duty’, but actually, ‘income resulting from storms’; same as vāt-ādeya. See bhūta-vāta-pratyāya, etc.
va-ti (IE 8-1), contraction of vadya-pakṣa-tithi, though va may be a mistake for ba (bahula).
vāt-ottara (IE 8-5), ‘resulting from storms’; cf. vāt-ādeya, etc.
vātoḍarīya (EI 22), epithet of gift land; probably a corruption of vāt-ottarīya; cf. sa-bhūta-vāt-ādeya, etc.
